notes.title: New Update with new music and much more!
notes.content:
Hello Dancers, 

You asked for it and we listened. Today we are dropping the third update of our early access release. We got tons of new songs with various styles to get you bumping and grooving. 

Lots of new music  
Feel the Energy - Katnip feat. Emmi 
Head Under Water - Lvly feat. Coby Effect
In the Name of Love - Flux Vortex 
Moon and Tide - Particle House 
Mr. Boogle - Adam K & Trippy Gilmore
No Money On My Mind - Lvly feat. Dai
Party Bangers - Qeeo
Tropical Storm - Cacti (Cospe Remix) 
You Get All of Me - Katnip feat. Astyn Turr 

New Levels of Difficulty
Introducing two new difficulty levels for all the songs. Basic & Pro mode.
In Basic mode, choreographies keep the essence of the dance but are more repetitive so you can pick up on the moves better. Some of the moves are slowed down a bit.

Pro mode are the dances as created by the choreographer. It is the best way to experience the game. We hope that you build up enough stamina to play the songs in Pro mode. 

Let us know what you think about this new update.
We welcome your feedback and bug reports. Please join our discord page.

https://discord.com/invite/pkg47uvGdp

Have fun and keep dancing

notes.title: SDH v0.3 Update is Fire!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are releasing today the second update of our early access. Here is the list of the new features:

2 New Songs
Just Wanna Run by Blanches (COE Remix) and Free Your Mind by Vicki Vox

Achievements
Track progression throughout the game. 

Spectator mode
We have added a spectator mode for the house party. You can activate it in the settings menu. 

Custom Dance Cues
You can now change the color of the dance cues, choose a color for each hand to better differentiate left and right, and even remove the cues entirely if you wish.

YUR Integration
We have also integrated YUR for players who want to track their caloric expenditure

Let us know what you think about this new update.
We welcome your feedback and bug reports. Please join our discord page.

https://discord.com/invite/pkg47uvGdp

Have fun and keep dancing

notes.title: One month of playtests runs successfully
notes.content:
Over the past month we have been running Space Dance Harmony playtests using steams new playtest account. We got 100 people playtesting and providing feedback. That's amazing! 

Here are some of the top requests, do you agree? Do you have any other ideas?
Please let us know! ːsteamhappyː

- Ability to add your own music and design custom choreographies 
- Full body tracking
- Training mode to master your skills 
- To distinguish left and right moves with color codes. 
- A step by step tutorial

Best regards,

Phenomena

notes.title: Play Testers Wanted!

We are looking for awesome people with all types of profiles to play our new virtual reality dance game and offer some awesome feedback. We have worked thousands of hours on this project and we are delighted to be able to share it with you all. We are committed to listen to users so please feel free to provide us with feedback, remarks and help us build the ultimate VR dance game ever!
